title: Survival Enhancements
description: Tons of survival enhancements that only try to improving existing things, and not add new mechanics. Supports 1.21.8 (1.21.9 and 1.21.10 coming soon!)
body:
# Features
Vanilla Survival Enhancements is a modpack that attempts to enhance aspects of survival minecraft like more structures, naturally trimmed mobs, more end biomes, faster decaying leaves, naturally spawning brown mooshrooms, more building blocks, more biomes, more concrete, more glass, and more! Vanilla Survival Enhancements has two types of versions one with less mods but updated to the newest version and one that isn't on the newest version but has more survival enhancing mods
